title: 検証～ネコ語は実在するのか？

text_block_list.text: Hearing a strange voice coming from behind the main hall, I head around to check it out…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Meow mew mew! Mew mew mew! Meeeooow!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there you go! That's it! You're sounding way better!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. I'm just giving Spe a little lesson in cat language.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …I heard something strange and came to investigate. And here you are, acting as strange as you sound.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Air Groove. You wouldn't by chance be interested too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ridiculous. There's no way cats could have a language remotely similar to ours.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oho, you think it's impossible? Well, how about a demonstration?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This is your chance, Spe. Go ahead and try that cat greeting I taught you earlier.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Got it! Um… Meeew.

text_block_list.name: Relaxing Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I did it, Sei! The cat answered me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All it did was meow back. I hardly think that could be considered a meaningful exchange of language.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heh. Why don't you go on and give it a try then?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph… fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Mew!
Unfortunately, after hearing Air Groove's meow, the cat runs off.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?!
Air Groove tries a few more meows… but the cat simply runs away each time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Urgh! What's going on here?! Why did it meow at everyone but me?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I think the problem's your pronunciation. Not to be rude, but it was a little presumptuous for you to think you could simply copy the sound.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wha… Are you mocking me? This is simply inexcusable!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's not it, Vice President. I'm just surprised you messed up a simple "hello" is all…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'd be even better than me if you practiced a bit, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Very well. I'll have to show you what happens when the Empress gets serious.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooh! How exciting! Say "meow meow!"
choice_data_list: Sky, why don't you get serious too?
You could start by teaching her the basics.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's right. If you're going to claim that cat language is real, it would be more effective to start with an example.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, whatever you saaay… Let's see… Ahem…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mew mew mew. Meow, meeeooow. Meow meow meow?

text_block_list.name: Relaxing Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: …Mew. Mew mew. Mew meeew! Meow meow meow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the?! Are you really communicating?!
Seiun Sky showcases her surprisingly impressive fluency in cat language, leaving everyone stunned as they watch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mraow, mraow! Nya-ha-ha! Mew mew mew. Meooow, meow…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uh, Sei? I think that might be enough—are you listening?
Seiun Sky and the cat she's talking with both suddenly stand up and swiftly dash away…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Meooow!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei?! Did you turn into a cat?!
When Seiun Sky returns, she claims she can't remember anything but feels like she's gotten plenty of exercise.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay then, allow me to explain. First, don't make eye contact with the cats. You've got to show them you're not hostile.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Once they trust you, you can try a greeting. And you've got to say it gently, like… "mew."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: M-mew.

text_block_list.name: Plump Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: …Mew.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh! It responded!
With Seiun Sky's help, Air Groove manages a clumsy conversation with the cat…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Thank you. I suppose this is as good a result as I could expect. It was fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm not entirely convinced that cat language exists.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy. Still won't accept it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, I do accept that your faculties for perception and understanding are quite something.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You can tell how cats feel and call out to them appropriately. It's astonishing in and of itself that you're able to empathize with cats to such an extent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll need more time to draw my final conclusion… but this was rather interesting—as is the notion of cats speaking.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! She praised you, Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but she wouldn't admit that cat language is real. Though I guess things went purrretty well! ♪
